Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

nLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash

```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

dLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

```

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start

```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

rLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

vLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start

```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

rLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

aLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

eLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

`Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

aLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

!Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

```

| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

cLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start

```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.


Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

?Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

rLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

9Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start

```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

lLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

```bash
cd backend && npm ci

cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

gLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

1Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

.Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

SLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

mLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

sLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

aLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

sLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

dLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

```bash
cd backend && npm ci

cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

tLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

/Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

eLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

)Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

 Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

`Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start

```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

 Load demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

dLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

oLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

```bash
cd backend && npm ci

cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start

```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

SLoad demo data (listings, users and bookings in every status):

```bash
docker-compose exec backend npm run seed     # owner: host@demo.dev / demo1234 · traveler: guest@demo.dev / demo1234
```

**Configuration**

| Variable | Where | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REACT_APP_API_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:4000/api` | API base URL (Socket.IO uses the same host) |
| `REACT_APP_AI_AGENT_URL` | frontend build | `http://localhost:8000` | AI travel-agent service |
| `MONGO_URL` | backend | local MongoDB | app data + sessions |
| `KAFKA_ENABLED` | backend | `true` | set `false` to run without a broker; booking events then go straight to WebSockets |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | backend | `http://localhost:3000` | comma-separated origins allowed for REST and WebSocket |
| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
MONGO_URL=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/airbnb KAFKA_ENABLED=false JWT_SECRET=dev npm start
cd ../frontend && npm ci && npm start
```

**End-to-end test** (needs a running MongoDB): `cd backend && npm run test:e2e` runs 15 checks covering auth, listing search, the booking lifecycle, the overlap guard, favorites, owner stats, and both real-time socket events.

| `JWT_SECRET` | backend | none | token signing key |

**Without Docker (no Kafka needed)**

```bash
cd backend && npm ci
